# IV Salt Rejuvenation

> Mobile IV hydration and wellness serving the Treasure Coast of Florida (Martin County and St. Lucie County: Port St. Lucie, Stuart, Palm City, and Jensen Beach). Every IV is administered by a licensed Registered Nurse under the supervision of a medical director, delivered to your home or office. Book online; a $50 deposit and a medical consent form confirm each appointment.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ivsaltfl.com/): Overview, IV therapy menu, how it works, service area, and FAQ.
- [Book an appointment](https://ivsaltfl.com/book): Choose a therapy, add boosts, pick a time, and enter your details. Up to 4 guests per visit.
- [Blog](https://ivsaltfl.com/blog): IV therapy and wellness articles by Sara A. Carroll, BSN, RN.
- [Getting Your First IV: What to Expect](https://ivsaltfl.com/blog/getting-your-first-iv-what-to-expect/): A step-by-step guide for first-time clients.

## IV therapy menu
- Hydration Haven ($200, ~90 min): Classic electrolyte hydration for freshness and energy.
- Salt & Sand Infusion ($220, ~90 min): Signature rejuvenation blend to refresh and energize.
- Immunity Wave ($230, ~90 min): Immune support infusion.
- Beauty Elixir ($260, ~90 min): Vitamin blend for skin, hair, and nails.
- Recovery Therapy ($240, ~90 min): Reduces inflammation and speeds recovery.
- NAD+ Therapy (from $300, ~4 hours): Cellular health, energy, and healthy aging.

## Add-ons
- B-12 Injection ($40), Zofran anti-nausea ($40), Toradol pain relief ($40), Weight Loss Support Shot ($50), NAD+ Shot ($75), Extra Boost of Glutathione, Vitamin C, or Zinc ($60).
